CFTC loses emergency effort to block New York action against Kalshi
summary: A US judge has rejected a request from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to temporarily block the New York Attorney General from pursuing their legal case against prediction market Kalshi.
content: A US judge has denied an emergency request by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to temporarily block the New York Attorney General from proceeding with a legal case against the prediction market Kalshi. The decision allows state authorities to continue their legal efforts involving the platform, marking a setback for federal regulatory attempts to intervene in the state-level dispute.

Silverflow launches modular in-person payments tech
summary: Silverflow, the cloud-native payments processing platform, now offers a complete modular in-person payment solution designed for modern acquirers.
content: Cloud-native payments processing platform Silverflow has launched a new modular in-person payments technology solution. Designed specifically for modern acquirers, the comprehensive offering aims to streamline physical payment processing by leveraging flexible, cloud-based infrastructure. This development expands Silverflow's service capabilities beyond traditional online transactions into the in-person retail and point-of-sale ecosystem.
